summary: Boilerplate, interviewer's formal introduction of Branford Marsalis (with a repeated take after a beeping noise), and greetings on May 24, 2012.

Today is May 24, 2012 and this is the Smithsonian Oral History Interview with saxophonist, composer, bandleader, educator, radio and TV personality and erstwhile thespian, or actor, NEA Jazz Master Branford Marsalis in his home in Durham, North Carolina. Good morning Mr. Marsalis, how are you doing?
Good morning, Mr. Brown. How are you?
OK. If we can go ahead and forgo the formalities if I may call you Branford, you can call me whatever you want.

OK. So since this is the NEA Jazz Masters interview conducted by Anthony Brown, assisted by Ken Kimery. Let’s go ahead and start from the beginning and get the…. (beeping noise in background) We might have to deal with that.

OK. Go ahead…. Good Morning, how are you doing?
